question: Which among the following folk dances is associated with Rajasthan?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kalbelia.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Kalbelia **is a **famous folk dance** of **Rajasthan** that is performed by the **Kalbelia tribe** of the state.
 
• The dance form is known for its **graceful movements of women** in long, black flowing skirts and men playing musical instruments like** pungi, dholak, and daf.**
 
• The dance is also famous for its **snake-like movements**, which are inspired by the movements of the Kalbelia tribe's traditional occupation of catching snakes.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Rouf i**s a folk dance of **Kashmir,** which is performed during the **harvesting season** and **involves rhythmic movements** of men and women in colorful costumes.
 
• **Bihu** is a folk dance of **Assam,** which is performed during the **Bihu festival** and involves energetic movements of men and women in traditional attire.
 
• **Lavani** is a folk dance of **Maharashtra**, which is performed by women and involves a mix of **sensuality and folk culture.**
